name: Canal Front Residences By Meydan
overview: Canal Front Residences, a new Meydan development, is an elite residential property located in the heart of the Dubai Water Canal. The project has one-, two-, and three-bedroom seaside apartments with modern furnishings, fixtures, and cutting-edge infrastructure for a really pleasant and convenient living experience. Canal Front Residences, located in a peaceful and family-friendly setting, offers its inhabitants convenient access to numerous facilities as well as accessibility to the rest of the city.
